flashcard_questions.q: Hardwood timber comes from which kind of tree?
Which type of timber comes from coniferous evergreen trees?
Why is balsa chosen for model-making?
Which manufactured board is made from veneers glued at right angles?
Which ferrous metal is very hard but brittle, used for manhole covers?
Why is copper used for electrical wiring?
flashcard_questions.a: It is an excellent conductor of electricity.

flashcard_questions.q: Brass is an alloy of ____ and ____.

flashcard_questions.a: A polymer that softens when heated and can be reshaped repeatedly.

flashcard_questions.q: Which polymer type sets permanently when heated and cannot be reshaped?
Which thermosetting polymer is used for kitchen worktops because it resists heat?
What is ductility in a material?
flashcard_questions.a: The ability to be stretched into a thin wire without breaking.

flashcard_questions.q: Which working property is the ability to be hammered or pressed into shape?
What is toughness in a material?
flashcard_questions.a: The ability to absorb impact energy without fracturing.

notes: 14 cards: 5 term→definition, 4 property/use→material, 3 material→use, 1 two-blank cloze on brass, 1 causal. Dropped the raw 'name three ferrous metals' style enumerations in favour of one identifying fact each.
